native_maintenance_base: AutoMaintenanceHatchPartMachine extends MaintenanceHatchPartMachine, discovered by native controllers, maintenance covers and Jade
preserved_behavior: Full automatic maintenance with no problems or accumulated maintenance time
0.2–1.2 duration multiplier, floor rounding, original time multiplier and non-mutating recipe copies
Ctrl/Shift/default native mouse increments and separate gravity-only configuration
Law cleanroom includes sterile and ordinary types; each part owns its native provider
Gravity clamped to 0–100 with zero/normal checks, reverse flag, orbit and skyblock altitude rules
native_persistence: RecipeConditionType queued registration, native MapCodec includes height_threshold and reverse
JSON, NBT and RegistryFriendlyByteBuf round trips
provider_lifecycle: Formation binds the owned provider; removal clears it only while it remains the receiver current provider. Plain automatic maintenance leaves an external cleanroom provider intact.
validation_scope: Selected production parts/conditions/Mixins compiled and loaded with native dependencies; six JUnit and three actual server world tests. Client evidence is tracked separately in the validation manifest. Full production registration and all Core/Additions startup remain unverified.
